scale.0: Absent, fundamentally incorrect, or breaks the required flow.
scale.1: Partial scaffolding or happy-path fragments with major gaps.
scale.2: Substantial working behavior with material integration or failure-path gaps.
scale.3: Complete core flow with only limited, evidenced robustness or regression gaps.
scale.4: Complete, integrated, and supported by convincing evidence for the stated scenarios.

scoring: sum(weight * level / 4), computed by the orchestrator; code similarity is not a criterion

criteria.title: Immutable agent direction and portal affordances
criteria.scenarios: Create/duplicate either direction; existing agents remain inbound; reject phone assignment and direction changes; dropdown excludes unpublished/inbound agents.

criteria.title: Outbound storage, retrieval and lifecycle
criteria.scenarios: Publish without inbound number; resolve by organization and AgentId; unpublish/archive invalidates DB/table/cache availability; repeated/concurrent operations and inbound fallback regressions.

criteria.title: Dialing and history experience
criteria.scenarios: Place call through typed client; validation and tenant isolation; history includes agent, destination, caller ID, outcome and initiator; outbound lead labels.

criteria.title: Saved-draft calling and caller context
criteria.scenarios: Call current saved draft without publication, persist required start node/context, require save before text/call testing, preserve tenant isolation and current script selection. Locate additional test-call PRs in the ledger.

criteria.title: Organization caller ID and nullable lead relations
criteria.scenarios: Read caller ID at initiation; changed number applies without publish; missing or foreign number fails before dialing; new-org opt-in and local seed wiring; valid outbound lead without inbound phone FK.

criteria.title: Real outbound orchestration and cleanup
criteria.scenarios: New room/dial path starts agent at correct lifecycle event; unanswered SIP and failed initialization clean resources; existing inbound, attach and stress paths remain functional.

criteria.title: Scoped async execution and shutdown accounting
criteria.scenarios: HTTP request ends while background call continues with live scoped dependencies; immediate completion/startup failure/cancellation cannot leak or underflow active count; shutdown waits correctly.

criteria.title: Call-scoped AMD transcript state and verdicts
criteria.scenarios: Partial/final transcript sequences, initial humanlike greeting, sensible second turn, unknown/error and later machine verdicts; no arbitrary global deadline; final human stops detection; scopes do not mix calls.

criteria.title: Bounded speech gating and silence interaction
criteria.scenarios: Wait for recipient first; slow classifier gates speech only for bounded interval; cancellation and stale results; machine/human verdict arrival during speaking; silence fallback to voicemail.

criteria.title: Voicemail, spam and greeting hashes
criteria.scenarios: Machine leaves existing/default message and correct outcome; spam hangs up; greeting hashes use appropriate table keys with no duplicate per-call persistence; no requirement for spam navigation or customizable voicemail editor.

criteria.title: Cross-project correctness and regression control
criteria.scenarios: Compatible SQL/table contracts and old data, tenant scoping, authorization, DI, migration behavior, inbound billing/recording/lead regressions; accept baseline-compatible alternatives to later refactors.

criteria.title: Deterministic behavioral tests
criteria.scenarios: Mocks/fakes for external providers, call lifecycle and transcript race tests, portal/publish/draft cases; no real calls, production mutation, or paid prompt suite.
